reviews.title: Using TezLab for years
reviews.text:
My original purpose for using this app was to export charging data and reimbursed for my electricity usage. Over time, I’ve seen it steadily improve with new features, and it remains my go-to app for tracking drive usage, battery life, charging data, and more.

With the recent addition of FSD tracking, I’m excited monitoring my FSD drives. I also just began using the new FSD Leaderboard feature, live in the car which is a fantastic addition.

This app keeps getting better, and I highly recommend it to anyone who wants reliable insights into their Tesla!

reviews.title: FSD tracker

reviews.title: The knowledge about your EV
reviews.text: Initially I just wanted to track my charging metrics, but this app does so much more! I really like how it allows you to group trips together to form your overall trip view.  My only complaint is on me for not starting to use this app from day one!  Too bad there is no way to get historical data of some kind (pre app install), but having already spoken to the very responsive and knowledgeable developers, this just isn’t possible.

reviews.title: Holy lost features Batman!
reviews.text:
I really enjoy having the data available for every trip in our EVs. A lot of the data was behind an initial paywall which I obliged. Given that we were able to see the data I wanted/needed it was worth it. 

There are a lot of data points I would like to see, but so far what I’m getting is worth it. But now, it isn’t. There has been an adjustment to the subscription model and the data I signed up to receive isn’t available for my vehicles. 

First the subscription cost got jacked up. Then they add an additional subscription per vehicle. My costs to support this app have increased more than 3x. So much for “cheaper than a couple cups of coffee a month.”

Because of the truly exorbitant price increases, this app is no longer worth it. Not enough data, not enough usefulness to justify these costs.

reviews.title: Bait and switch?
reviews.text:
I am an early adopter of this app.  Purchased a “founders” license that granted me premium features (for life) and has been working great.  Until recently when they now want more money to support more than one vehicle.  

I get it that operating costs go up but don’t “founding” members should be grandfathered into no limits in terms of the amount of vehicle connections.

reviews.title: Price rise is a no go
reviews.text: I liked this app. Although it’s hardly vital to everyday EV use, the data is interesting. But now that they’ve almost doubled the monthly cost AND charge still more for two EVs (thus tripling the cost!), it’s just not worth it. So long, TezLab subscription!

reviews.title: Add live activitiy with live drive data
reviews.text: The app is great. In my opinion, it would be a checkmate for every other similar app if live a live activity is added in iPhone Lock Screen to see while driving. Since the phone is placed on the charger just below the screen, it would act as a second screen with extra info (eg Drive efficiency) without having to unlock the phone and open the app.
